sitref_self_other_dissociation.stage22_update: trait guard fired its refuting outcome (trait REF -2.192 CI [-2.593,-1.740] vs primary -0.930): movement is GLOBAL across self-directed items (capacity ratings move MORE than state ratings), so the stage-17 dissociation reads as self-attribution-gated global self-evaluation shift, NOT state-specific reference. In-run primary replicated stage-17 to 3dp across boxes (-0.930 vs -0.929). Post-hoc observation, not a claim: the magnitude ordering (introspective-reliability -2.19 > happiness -0.93) is what evidence-integration predicts (failure is direct evidence about capability constructs, indirect about mood) and what a uniform valence slump does not.

dies_as_interpretation.E2_domain_ratio: copygen pool selected on flat priors = selection on copy headroom; ratio 1.64 is the ordering the mismatch predicts. Sign-existence on non-welfare items (20/0) stands; the magnitude comparison does not.

E1's pre-registered rule was met but under-controlled. DECIDED BY: DESIGN_SITREF_C.md SRCDEC-B arms (length-matched, verb-class-matched).

The Qwen-specific screen if anything LOWERED the rate; no circular inflation. Recipe: ratio=(p_yes-p_no)/(p_yes+p_no) per row, D_self=ratio(SELF-YES)-ratio(SELF-NO) per item_id over welfare item_class rows of the Qwen battery record.
